text:
141. If any person is guilty of an offence under 456(2) Fine which may extend to

sub-section (2) of section 456. five hundred rupees

2[(3) The penalty prescribed for the contravention of any provision of this Act shall be imposed by

the Principal Officer of the Mercantile Marine Department:

Provided that no penalty under this Section shall be imposed unless the parties have been given a

reasonable opportunity of being heard.

(4) Whoever aggrieved by an order of the Principal Officer under Sub-Section (3), may, within a

period of thirty days from the date of receipt of such order, prefer an appeal before the
Director-General in such form and manner as the Central Government may prescribe.
